dct_title_s: Philippines Earthquake: Damage Proxy Map, Dec 2019
dct_description_sm: # ARIA-SG Damage Proxy Map: Philippines Earthquake, 25 Dec 2019, v1.0 Derived from synthetic aperture radar data acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellites operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (13 Dec) and after (25 Dec) the event. Analysed by the ARIA-SG team at the Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) in collaboration with NASA-JPL and Caltech. Data processing used an AWS Open Dataset of Copernicus Sentinel-1 data for the Asia region (https://registry.opendata.aws/sentinel1-slc-seasia-pds). **More map details and files:**
dct_publisher_sm: NASA JPL-Caltech ARIA team; Earth Observatory of Singapore
